name: Young Astronaut
description: Final GPU-reviewed model: 6088 triangles, 0.876402 × 1.8 × 1.084661 m. Soles at Y=0. Six shared material roles, 16-joint hierarchy, 8-second closed Friendly_Wave loop. No skin/facial deformation.
brief: Approved young-astronaut-concept-01.png: stocky ivory Mars astronaut, opaque navy visor, orange pads, slate gloves/boots, backpack cyan display. 1.8m tall, <=8000 triangles. Articulated rigid rig and wave; display next to rover.

metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.
metrics.openSurfaceScope: Visible static open surfaces sampled at their vertices against visible static closed solids, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes open-vs-open pairs, motion, and any solid thinner than the sampled surface's facet spacing. Penetration within the contact tolerance is treated as intended contact, and penetration beyond it may still be intentional, as a fitting socketed into a shell is.

metrics.instanceabilitySummary: C (informational, not a QA verdict), set by 6 distinct materials (C at 4-6). Also: 43 geometries; 77 draw calls. Optional advice, not a requirement: merging smooth-structure + accent-paint + smooth-structure:structure-gray + dark-trim and 1 more (differ in baseColorFactor, metallicFactor, roughnessFactor) would leave 2 materials (B at 2-3).
